definitions.gloss: resident; occupant; tenant; person who moves in
definitions.explanation: A person who moves into and lives in a dwelling, facility, or building. Used for apartments, care facilities, and similar residences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧きた。
{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: We put out an advertisement looking for tenants.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{老人|ろうじん}ホーム→老人ホーム：28075_roujinhoomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The residents of this nursing home do radio calisthenics every morning.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧ (moving in, taking up residence) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used in both real estate and care facility contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: seeking tenants/residents
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{募集中|ぼしゅうちゅう}: now accepting residents
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{向|む}け⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: services for residents
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}: new tenant/resident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{居住者|きょじゅうしゃ}→居住者：16923_kyojuusha⟧: resident, inhabitant — more formal and general; can refer to anyone living somewhere
- ⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧: resident, dweller — more casual; emphasizes being a longtime inhabitant
- ⟦テナント→テナント：23088_tenanto⟧: tenant (loanword) — typically used for commercial tenants in a building
